name: Yadaphone
description: Cheap international calls from the browser, with no app and no phone verification. Pay-as-you-go credit, aimed at freelancers and businesses that call abroad (company-stated). Founded Mar 2025, AT.

mentions.evidence: MRR ~$1,060, 405 active subscriptions, ~$13,358 L30 (+10.0%), ~$39,021 last 3 months, ~$179,571 last 12 months, ~$259,247 all-time. Revenue synced Oct 8, 2026 ~06:33 Warsaw (04:33 UTC).
mentions.indieAngle: Make it a diaspora utility: "call a Polish number from the UK/DE/NL in your browser" for Poles abroad who need to reach ZUS, banks, clinics or family. Twilio or Telnyx in the back end, Stripe top-ups, and SEO pages per destination and institution.

whyItPrints: Telecom arbitrage with a modern UX. People who need to call a bank, a government office or family abroad top up and forget. ~$180k in the last 12 months, and L30 is up 10%. MRR is small because most revenue is credit top-ups rather than subscriptions (my inference from MRR vs L30).
